entries.summary: A modern, lightweight Mihomo / Clash Meta GUI client built with Tauri and Rust
entries.description: Continuity submission. Zephyr's Flathub submission PR (flathub/flathub#9810) was closed; omapak picked it up. Original app by Juwan-Hwang (MIT, 700+ stars, actively maintained). Manifest adapted from the Flathub submission with sources still pinned to upstream release v2.4.3.

entries.summary: IPFS Desktop, the official desktop client for the InterPlanetary File System
entries.description: Continuity submission. IPFS Desktop (6.5k stars, MIT) had its Flathub submission (flathub/flathub#10144) closed after the submitter questioned the AI policy checklist and was told "No, AI is not allowed in submission process". omapak picked it up. Manifest from that PR unchanged: pinned upstream deb, Electron BaseApp, x-checker-data wired for updates.

entries.summary: LibreDB Studio, the open-source database IDE
entries.description: Continuity submission. LibreDB Studio (557 stars, MIT, pushed the day of this submission) had its Flathub submission (flathub/flathub#9538) closed by its own author, with honor, after asking directly whether using an AI code-assistant during development conflicted with the policy. The moderator's answer: "yes. It is vibecoded as he[ll]." The author thanked him for the direct answer, kept his word, and closed the PR himself. omapak's answer to the same question is no.
